map.跑道所需长度（海拔/温度修正） 使用指南: Required Runway Length (altitude / temperature correction) User Guide
map.依据海拔高度、气温与机型性能参数，修正并计算起飞着陆所需跑道长度，适用于飞行计划: From altitude, air temperature and aircraft performance parameters, correct and compute the runway length needed for takeoff and landing, for flight planning, airport operation assessment and constrained performance analysis.
map.高原/高温机场，按基准跑道长度叠加海拔密度高度修正与温度修正，得实际需要长度。: For plateau or hot airports, add altitude density-height and temperature corrections to the baseline runway length to get the length actually needed.
map.评估酷暑或高海拔时起飞重量是否需削减（跑道不够长）。: Assess whether takeoff weight must be cut in extreme heat or at high altitude (runway not long enough).
map.对比不同机型基准长度与修正量，做机场适用性判断。: Compare baseline lengths and corrections across aircraft types to judge airport suitability.
map.：基准跑道长度 2500 m，海拔 1000 m 密度高度修正约 +8%、气温高: : baseline runway length 2500 m, density altitude correction at 1000 m elevation about +8%, plus about +5% where temperature exceeds ISA by 15 °C, giving about 2500 × 1.13 ≈ 2825 m needed. In practice follow the correction tables in the aircraft performance manual.
map.由动压、升力系数与面积求升力: Lift from dynamic pressure, lift coefficient and area
map.为什么高温高海拔跑道要更长？: Why do hot and high runways need to be longer?
map.海拔高、温度高→空气密度低→同等表速下动压小、升力与发动机推力都下降，需要更长滑: High altitude and high temperature mean lower air density, so at the same indicated speed dynamic pressure is smaller and both lift and engine thrust fall, requiring a longer ground roll to reach liftoff speed; hence a longer runway or a lower takeoff weight.
map.坡度、顶风怎么影响？: How do slope and headwind affect it?
map.上坡增加所需长度、下坡减少；顶风缩短、顺风加长。完整性能计算把这些修正一并叠加，: Uphill increases the required length and downhill reduces it; headwind shortens it and tailwind lengthens it. Full performance calculation stacks these corrections together, and this tool illustrates with the given altitude and temperature terms.
